Indian Student's US F-1 Visa Revoked Amidst Income Disclosure

An Indian student from Hyderabad, who traveled to the US in January 2025 on an F-1 visa for studies, reportedly had his visa revoked without prior warning. This occurred after he returned to India for a brief visit. Another report indicates that an F-1 visa was denied to an Indian student after they disclosed their family income to a visa officer, despite having secured a Rs 1.24 crore education loan. The incidents raise questions about the process of F-1 visa revocation and denial for Indian students.
